name: mermaid-gui-markdown-editor
description: Windows 11 GUI Markdown and Mermaid Editor

scripts.electron:dev: wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run compile:electron && node -e "const env={...process.env,VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL:'http://localhost:5173'};delete env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE;require('child_process').spawn(require('electron'),['.'],{env,stdio:'inherit'}).on('exit',c=>process.exit(c||0))"
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run compile:electron && vite build
scripts.build:extension: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run compile:chrome && node dist-chrome/build-extension.js
